Skill names link to their source. Read the install guide there before enabling
a skill. Inclusion is not a security audit. Use Cmd+F or Ctrl+F to search.

 
 

 Document & File Processing

 Skill Use it to 
 --- --- 
 cue-omni-reader Parse documents and web sources into text through the Cue Omni Reader MCP service. 
 [docx][docx] Create and edit Word documents with tracked changes and comments. 
 equalang Translate files or transcribe recordings through Equalang using an API key and credits. 
 humanpen Rewrite, translate, shorten, and restyle citations in files through paid HumanPen APIs. 
 mubu-integration Import, export, and organize Mubu outlines and Markdown through an unofficial API. 
 [pdf][pdf] Extract text and tables, combine PDFs, and fill forms. 
 [pptx][pptx] Create, edit, and inspect PowerPoint presentations. 
 rtl-slides Build right-to-left Persian and Arabic reveal.js presentations with localized digits, Jalali/Hijri dates, and PDF/PNG export. 
 translate-book Translate papers and books with a LaTeX-source route for preserving arXiv equations and tables. 
 [xlsx][xlsx] Build and edit spreadsheets with formulas and formatting. 

 

 Testing & Quality

 Skill Use it to 
 --- --- 
 aeo-check Lint a site's code or live URL for what blocks AI search and agents, fix findings in framework order, then re-run to confirm. 
 agent-qa-authoring Author and validate agent-qa tests and IDs; source license restricts competing use. 
 align Collect structured feedback on generated claims in an HTML form and archive corrections for later review. 
 benchmark-yylo Prepare reusable cases, compare models/harnesses and independently evaluate retained outputs. 
 checkup Run hosted probes and retrieve server-scored results; full mode uploads approved conversation logs. 
 clousd Test Android apps on cloud phones: run plain-language tasks or drive the screen step by step. 
 crosscheck Compare independent Claude and Codex analysis, reconcile findings, and verify completed work. 
 design-fidelity-verify Compare measured values in a running app with a Figma design specification. 
 fresh-review Review code or a plan against acceptance criteria with an agent that has not seen the conversation, then label each finding. 
 ironloop Plan Rust work through specifications, tests, simulation, and authorized security checks. 
 never-again Capture repaired bugs as enforceable hooks or brief lessons for future sessions. 
 pdp-audit Audit ecommerce product pages with desktop/mobile evidence and prioritized UX findings. 
 playwright-expert Write and debug Playwright browser tests with fixtures, page objects, visual checks, and CI integration. 
 prove-it-ran Show evidence that tests and builds actually ran and covered the change before calling work done. 
 sim (interview-sim) Practice timed coding interviews with script-managed clocks and hidden-test grading. 
 test-checklist Derive a QA plan from app code with steps and expected results for each platform. 
 [test-driven-development][tdd] Write a failing test, implement the change, then refactor. 
 test-master Plan and implement unit, integration, performance, and security tests with coverage and defect analysis. 
 [webapp-testing][webapp-testing] Exercise a local web app with Playwright and inspect its behavior. 
 what-could-break Trace a change through consumers, stored data and duplicated rules, then design a concrete check for the critical assumption. 
 wreck-it Test a local web app like real users and chaos monkeys, then report reproduced bugs with screenshots, source locations and regression tests. 

 

 Debugging & Troubleshooting

 Skill Use it to 
 --- --- 
 agenttrace-session-audit Inspect agent sessions for cost, tokens, failures, and latency. 
 debugging-wizard Reproduce failures, test hypotheses, identify root causes, and verify fixes. 
 solidping-monitoring Find why an uptime check fails, read incidents, and add checks through the SolidPing MCP server. 
 [systematic-debugging][debugging] Investigate a bug's cause before attempting a fix. 
 [verification-before-completion][verification] Run checks and inspect their output before calling work done. 

 

 Collaboration & Workflow

 Skill Use it to 
 --- --- 
 a2ui-ask Collect structured user input through a browser form and JSON answer files. 
 ai-agency-os-starter Keep each client's voice, claims and scope isolated, and check client requests against the SOW before doing unbilled work. 
 ai-code-review-triage Review AI-written PRs in three passes: fresh-context bug hunt, context checks (units, history, callers), and a scoped sign-off. 
 ai-meeting Run structured proposal reviews with CLI agents and preserve each agent session between rounds. 
 ax-extract-workflow Reconstruct a shipped feature's workflow from local ax session history. 
 before-you-build Check demand, distribution, scope, and failure risks before building a product or feature. 
 [brainstorming][brainstorming] Work through requirements and design choices before implementation. 
 breather Offer session stopping points with attended-time context and a written handoff. 
 call-me Call or text the user's iPhone to ask or report, then act on the reply; needs the paid /call-me iPhone app. 
 clueless Name assumptions, irreversible steps, and review gaps when a user needs extra gui

install.title: Quick Start
install.html:
Install Anthropic's document skills in Claude Code from your terminal.

claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
claude plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills

Provide a PDF, then ask Claude to extract its form fields. Compare the result with your file. Read Anthropic's installation guide.

Other collections, standalone skills, and updates

Use each source repository's install guide. Collections may ship as plugins, individual folders, or both. Choose one route for each collection.

For a standalone Claude Code skill, put its folder in ~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/ for personal use, or .claude/skills/<skill-name>/ for one project. Keep SKILL.md and its supporting files together. See the Claude Code skill guide.

Follow the plugin update guide for plugin installs. For standalone folders, use the source repository's update instructions. Cloning this directory does not install the listed skills.
